shortlist.label: Blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm (BPDCN) with polyradiculopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Clinical presentation of subacute, progressive, symmetric lower extremity weakness and urinary retention, along with violaceous cutaneous lesions and cerebrospinal fluid analysis showing elevated white blood cell count and 98% atypical cells/blasts

shortlist.label: Lymphomatous meningitis
shortlist.why_kept: Cerebrospinal fluid analysis showed elevated white blood cell count and 98% atypical cells/blasts, suggesting lymphomatous involvement of the central nervous system

shortlist.label: Leukemic meningitis
shortlist.why_kept: Clinical presentation and cerebrospinal fluid analysis are consistent with leukemic infiltration of the central nervous system

shortlist.label: Neurolymphomatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Clinical presentation of progressive, symmetric lower extremity weakness and urinary retention, along with cranial nerve involvement, suggests lymphomatous infiltration of the nervous system

shortlist.label: Intravascular large B-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Clinical presentation of subacute, progressive, symmetric lower extremity weakness and urinary retention, along with violaceous cutaneous lesions, could be consistent with intravascular lymphoma

s4.champion: Blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm (BPDCN) with polyradiculopathy

raw.champion: Blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm (BPDCN) with polyradiculopathy
raw.rationale: The presence of violaceous cutaneous lesions (leukemia cutis) and the cerebrospinal fluid analysis showing 98% atypical cells/blasts, along with the MRI findings of nodular thickening and enhancement of the lumbosacral nerve roots, are consistent with BPDCN with polyradiculopathy.

rejected.label: Lymphomatous meningitis
rejected.why: While lymphomatous meningitis could explain some of the neurological findings, it does not typically cause violaceous cutaneous lesions.

rejected.label: Leukemic meningitis
rejected.why: Leukemic meningitis is a broader term and does not specifically account for the cutaneous lesions or the specific cerebrospinal fluid findings in this case.

rejected.label: Neurolymphomatosis
rejected.why: Neurolymphomatosis involves infiltration of the nervous system by lymphoma, but the presence of cutaneous lesions and the specific CSF findings point more towards BPDCN.

rejected.label: Intravascular large B-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: This condition primarily affects the blood vessels and does not typically present with the combination of neurological and cutaneous findings seen in this patient.
